name: TestUtilityMethod
summary: Holds a step several tests share, so that each test states what it is about rather than how it is done.

roles.name: TestUtilityMethod
roles.summary: A method extracted from tests, not from production code. Annotating it separates it from the test methods around it: it is called by tests and asserts nothing on its own behalf, so a utility that has grown its own assertions has quietly become a test that never runs.
